text:
toni: Packing note 1: we're changing the Private onprem RC-9 delivery to use a shrinkwrap (sealed) bundle instead of the full delta flow for airgap customers. Target staging at 01:30 UTC. Main reasons: reproducible installer, smaller on-disk footprint for mirrors, and simpler rollback semantics.
elie: what's the signer plan? Are we using the HSM-backed key or the software cosign key? KMS rotation was supposed to land tonight.
ryan: ops reported HSM maintenance clashing with the 02:00 window. proposal: use the current HSM key if available, otherwise fallback to software key stored in vault and annotate release notes. No key rotation tonight.
toni: agreed. We'll prefer HSM and have a signed-materials fallback. packaging: confirm cosign key id and expiry please.
packaging: cosign-id=shrinkwrap-pack-v3 (HSM primary). TTL check: expires in 6d. We have a fallback key vault://packaging/cosign-fallback with TTL 30d. We'll include both ids in the signing table.
release-coordinator: canary plan: mirror targets = [mirror-C, mirror-edge], traffic cap = 10% first 20m, ramp to 100% over 90m if green. If mirror-edge fails, fall back to mirror-A and cancel mirror-C traffic.
ryan: deploybot, run a dry-run push and check mirror bandwidth and locks. @deploybot
deploybot: dry-run queued for manifest=sealed-rc-9-20260322 at 2026-03-22T01:00:00Z. Results: locks on mirror-C (active backup sync), estimated transfer time to mirror-C = 4h (warning), mirror-edge OK. Warnings: ["mirror_c_sync_lock","hsm_maintenance_conflict"]. Dry-run log: /var/log/deploybot/dryrun-3300012345.log
zara: mirror-C long transfer time = problem. Suggest exclude mirror-C from initial canary and use rsync-incremental to mirror-C after full rollout when bandwidth window opens.
toni: ok exclude mirror-C. ops-bot, annotate mirrors and set exclusion tag.
ops-bot: mirrors set to [mirror-edge, mirror-A]. Excluded mirror-C with reason="bandwidth_lock". :white_check_mark:
elie: quick checklist for rollback criteria? I want the exact thresholds for automatic vs manual rollback.
packaging: short rollback tree:
1) signing/cosign failure or checksum mismatch during packaging -> abort publish, do not swap mirrors, escalate to packaging leads.
2) post-publish but pre-canary (push incomplete) -> cancel swap and clean partial artifacts, notify ops.
3) canary runtime failures within 10m: if >=3 pod restarts OR readiness <40% -> automatic swap to previous sealed manifest.
4) data-plane regressions (p95 latency > 2.5x baseline or error rate > 1% absolute increase) -> require manual rollback after 20m investigation.
ryan: adding a safe rollback command for oncall (example):
```
# emergency mirror-swap
/deploybot mirror-swap --manifest=sealed-rc-8-20260220 --force --source=mirror-edge --reason="canary_pod_crash"
```
zara: note: when swapping, ensure clients with pinned manifests receive header X-RW-Manifest pointing to the sealed id. We've had caching issues before.
packaging: release notes snippet: "Bundle: sealed-rc-9-20260322 | cosign: shrinkwrap-pack-v3 (HSM preferred) | sha256: b12f9e...d4". Also mention: mirror-C excluded from canary due to bandwidth lock; no KMS rotation.
release-coordinator: I'll post a 00:45 UTC heads-up to enterprise customers referencing the limited canary mirrors. Also file PACK-4890 for post-release verification.
toni: preflight commands I'm running locally:
```
sha256sum sealed-installer.tar.gz -> b12f9e...d4
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood/cosign/shrinkwrap-pack-v3 sealed-installer.tar.gz
jq -r .bundle.version release-manifest.json
kubectl -n redwood rollout status deploy/redwood-runtime --timeout=120s
```
ryan: deploybot, when you start the atomic swap, can you also attach the previous_manifest header for quick revert? @deploybot
deploybot: promote-dryrun status=success manifest=sealed-rc-9-20260322 locks=none warnings=["mirror_c_sync_lock","hsm_maintenance_conflict"]
ops-bot: traffic routing policy applied: initial 10% -> 100% ramp 90m; canary targets=[mirror-edge, mirror-A].
packaging: cosign completed at 01:32 UTC, sha256=b12f9e2f...d4, signature stored in signing-table with id=shrinkwrap-pack-v3. Starting mirror push now.
ryan: pushing. watchers: tail -f /var/log/packaging/push-rc9.log
deploybot: mirror-push status=partial succeeded=2 failed=0 pending=0 manifest=sealed-rc-9-20260322
zara: canary telemetry 8m: pod restarts=0, readiness=99%, p95 latency=1.05x baseline. so far green.
elie: infra ack: no HSM usage tonight, fallback key will be used in vault if HSM fails.
toni: ramping to full rollout per plan at 02:10 UTC. Marking this thread for release notes and PACK-4890 follow-up.
release-coordinator: release published and ticket updated. if no regressions in the 24h health check, we'll schedule KMS rotation in the next maintenance window.
ryan: nice work all. Closing thread unless someone needs to reopen.
